🕹️ GTA VI PC Port Takes Shape An open-source GitHub project is rebuilding the Xbox version of GTA VI for Windows. It has already become the platform’s most popular open-source project. The released files include models, textures, audio, and all 26,500 shaders translated for PC. The main missing piece is the.exe file, which CyberLeek is offering in exchange for a crypto scam, though it may later be published anyway. ✔️ Xbox version rebuilt for Windows ✔️ Models, textures, and audio extracted ✔️ 26,500 shaders translated for PC ✔️ The executable is still missing 👉 Github 👈 The port is not complete yet, while Rockstar could still disrupt the effort with an official PC release. 💻 @program
